title: Nuevos bombos para la Lotería Nacional, en el Colegio de San Ildefonso / New drums for the National Lottery, at the San Ildefonso school
license: unknown — NO-DO, Spanish state newsreel; no licence statement on rtve.es
notes: NO-DO NOT N 1024 C, August 1962, item 3 of 8 (187-229 s of the 9:18 reel): the new wire drums for the Spanish National Lottery arrive at the Colegio de San Ildefonso — the boys in uniform, the crates stencilled DIRECTOR GENERAL DE TRIBUTOS ESPECIALES / MADRID, the covers coming off, the wire sphere turning, and the numbered balls laid into the runnel. Spanish narration; no sung numbers in this item. Spain/Spanish. Fetched with yt-dlp (rtve.es:alacarta); cut from a pre-crop (crop=406:320:130:72) that removes the rtve.es and Filmoteca Española bugs.
